Requires: Drafting Machines.

technologies.title: Industrial Heat Recuperators
technologies.description:
Heaters in Factories and Workshops use no coal. Normal Heater unlocks, switches and power levels still apply. Production ingredients are unchanged; this improves workplace heating.

Requires: Difference Engine, Protected Healthcare Heating.

technologies.title: Industrial Heat Recuperators
technologies.description:
Heaters in Profiles Manufactures, Machine Shops, Foundries and Workshops use no coal. Normal Heater unlocks, switches and power levels still apply. Production ingredients are unchanged; this improves workplace heating.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators.

technologies.title: Compact Heating Grids
technologies.description:
The Generator uses 25% less coal and Steam Hubs use 40% less coal. Trade-off: all heat-zone radii shrink by 20%. Heater power is unaffected. Optional permanent specialisation for compact districts rather than wide heat coverage.

Requires: Difference Engine, District Steam Trunklines.

technologies.title: Compact Heating Grids
technologies.description:
Braziers use 40% less coal. Trade-off: all heat-zone radii shrink by 20%. Heater power is unaffected. Optional permanent specialisation for compact districts rather than wide heat coverage.

Requires: Difference Engine, Brazier District Networks.

technologies.title: Compact Heating Grids
technologies.description:
Braziers use 40% less coal. Trade-off: all heat-zone radii shrink by 20%. Heater power is unaffected. Optional permanent specialisation for compact districts rather than wide heat coverage.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators, Winter Shelter Lining.

technologies.title: Recuperating Accumulators
technologies.description:
Generator stress recovers 100% faster and the Generator uses 15% less coal. Develops Pressure-Buffer Boiler Drums into a system for recovering between overdrive periods; the earlier research and other fuel modifiers remain active.

Requires: Difference Engine.

technologies.title: Frostland Relay Workshops
technologies.description:
Scouts travel 150% faster and Factories gain 75% workplace efficiency for both work roles. Supports repeated Frostland exploration and processing recovered resources after Endless storms. Adds no expedition teams.

Requires: Difference Engine, Frostland Sled Overhaul.

technologies.title: Warehouse Recovery Lots
technologies.description:
Upgrades Warehouse Cutting Torches: 1 Steam Core and 20 coal produce 100 steel and 40 wood together in 6 working hours. The core is consumed. Adds a wood-recovery route to the core economy while preserving the Warehouse selector size.

Requires: Difference Engine, Warehouse Cutting Torches.

technologies.title: Reusable Formwork Systems
technologies.description:
Unlocks an optional Profiles Manufacture recipe: 1 steam exchanger and 18 wood produce 3 structural profiles in 2 working hours. Uses Machine Shop output to conserve timber and accelerate profile production.

Requires: Drafting Machines, Steam-Cured Profiles.

technologies.title: Sacrificial Mould Casting
technologies.description:
Unlocks an optional Foundry recipe: 1 structural profile, 10 steel and 45 coal produce 2 steel composites in 3 working hours. Consumes a profile as mould material to save steel and fuel.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators, Charcoal-Alloy Composites.

technologies.title: Composite Exchanger Dies
technologies.description:
Unlocks an optional Machine Shop recipe: 1 steel composite, 12 steel and 20 coal produce 3 steam exchangers in 3 working hours. Converts Foundry output into faster, steel-efficient exchanger production, completing a component-reuse chain.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators, Fuel-Tempered Exchangers.

technologies.title: Cold-Current Wooden Lures
technologies.description:
Upgrades Baited Nets with a bait-free recipe: 2 wood and 2 coal produce 8 raw food in 1 working hour, or 12 at an Advanced Fishing Harbour. Conserves food rations by spending wood and fuel. Replaces Baited Nets; Far-Water Trawling and Dockside Smokehouses remain available.

Requires: Drafting Machines, Baited Deep-Water Nets.

technologies.title: Forager Meal Routes
technologies.description:
Foragers travel 100% faster and Cookhouses gain 75% workplace efficiency. Moves crews between food sites sooner while increasing the capacity to process their deliveries. Adds no forager teams.

Requires: Drafting Machines, Forager Relay Markers.

technologies.title: Industrial Safety Dispensaries
technologies.description:
Profiles Manufactures, Machine Shops, Foundries and Reloading Stations gain +1 safety. Medical Posts and Infirmaries gain 100% healing efficiency. Combines accident-risk management with stronger treatment capacity; it does not prevent every accident.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators, Protected Fabrication Halls.

technologies.title: Public Assurance Offices
technologies.description:
Unlocks the signable Public Reassurance Charter in the upper charter branch of Adaptation (Administration in The Last Autumn). Hope rises greatly when signed. Public Houses, Fighting Arenas, Care Houses and places of worship gain +1 insulation.

Requires: No prior research.

technologies.title: Independent Grievance Offices
technologies.description:
Unlocks the signable Workers' Grievance Hearings in the upper charter branch of Adaptation (Administration in The Last Autumn). Discontent falls greatly when signed. Medical Posts and Infirmaries gain 75% healing efficiency for human crews and automatons.

Requires: Drawing Boards, Public Assurance Offices.

technologies.title: Public Recovery Standards
technologies.description:
Unlocks the signable Rest and Recovery Covenant in the upper charter branch of Adaptation (Administration in The Last Autumn). Hope rises moderately and discontent falls moderately when signed. Cold-related illness is reduced by 25%.

Requires: Drafting Machines, Independent Grievance Offices.

technologies.title: Civic Emergency Planning
technologies.description:
Unlocks the signable Storm Mutual Aid Charter in the upper charter branch of Adaptation (Administration in The Last Autumn). Hope rises greatly and discontent falls greatly when signed. Civic and healthcare buildings gain +2 insulation.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators, Public Recovery Standards.

technologies.title: Citywide Thermal Envelope IV
technologies.description:
Every building that uses insulation gains +1 insulation. Citizens also suffer 35% less cold-related illness.

Requires: Mechanical Calculators, Citywide Thermal Envelope III.

technologies.title: Citywide Thermal Envelope V
technologies.description:
Every building that uses insulation gains +1 insulation. All heat zones also gain 50% radius.

Requires: Difference Engine, Citywide Thermal Envelope IV.

technologies.title: Citywide Thermal Envelope VI
technologies.description:
Every building that uses insulation gains +2 insulation. Citizens also suffer 50% less cold-related illness.

Requires: Automatic Prototyping, Citywide Thermal Envelope V.
